event.name: DevFest Kisumu 2026
event.location: Lake Basin Convention Centre, Kisumu, Kenya
event.organizer: Google Developer Group (GDG) Kisumu & Women Techmakers
event.summary: The premier annual developer festival in Western Kenya bringing together technologists, software engineers, and founders to explore the frontier of AI, Cloud, Mobile, and Web technologies.

tracks.name: Victoria Hall (Main Stage)
tracks.description: Keynotes, Architecture, Key Innovations & Tech Leadership

tracks.name: Riat Stage (AI & Data)
tracks.description: Generative AI, Gemini APIs, Multimodal LLMs, & Data Engineering

tracks.name: Dunga Stage (Mobile & Web)
tracks.description: Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, Modern Web & UI Systems

tracks.name: Kavirondo Lab (Cloud & DevOps)
tracks.description: Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform, Platform Engineering & Security

speakers.name: Dr. Achieng Otieno
speakers.bio: Google Developer Expert in Machine Learning. Researcher focused on low-resource African languages and multimodal foundational models.

speakers.name: Brian Kiprop
speakers.bio: Android GDE and mobile engineering leader building fintech apps serving over 30 million East Africans daily. Passionate about Kotlin Multiplatform and offline-first apps.

speakers.name: Sharon Mwangi
speakers.bio: Advises enterprise organizations across Sub-Saharan Africa on scalable cloud modernization, serverless architectures, and reliable distributed systems.

speakers.name: Kevin Omondi
speakers.bio: Founder, ecosystem builder, and organizer of GDG Kisumu. Championing developer opportunities and youth tech empowerment in Western Kenya.

speakers.name: Faith Muthoni
speakers.bio: DevSecOps practitioner specializing in Zero Trust architecture, API security, and payment compliance across African borders.

speakers.name: David Okello
speakers.bio: Open source contributor and web performance evangelist. Exploring WebAssembly, Next-gen Web Vitals, and accessible African web applications.

speakers.name: Amina Hassan
speakers.bio: Building reliable pipelines for real-time inference and model observability in resource-constrained environments.

speakers.name: Joseph Barasa
speakers.bio: Go enthusiast, distributed systems designer, and Kubernetes contributor. Passionate about high-throughput networking and resilient backends.

sessions.title: Welcome & Opening Remarks: The State of Tech in Western Kenya
sessions.description: Opening keynote highlighting the growth of tech talent in the Lake Region, regional impact, and how local developers are competing globally.

sessions.title: Building Production Multimodal AI Systems with Gemini 2.0
sessions.description: Dive deep into multimodal prompting, structured JSON schema outputs, and grounding LLMs with real-time enterprise tools. Includes live code demonstrations on low-bandwidth inference optimization.

sessions.title: Kotlin Multiplatform in 2026: One Codebase, Native Speed on Android & iOS
sessions.description: How to scale KMP across large engineering teams without sacrificing iOS developer experience or native UI responsiveness. Real-world insights from migrating millions of active users.

sessions.title: Serverless at Scale: Designing Fault-Tolerant Microservices on Google Cloud
sessions.description: Best practices for deploying auto-scaling microservices on Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Spanner with predictable latency and 99.99% availability.

sessions.title: Morning Coffee & Networking Break
sessions.description: Connect with fellow attendees, explore sponsor booths, and recharge over tea and snacks.

sessions.title: Hardening Cloud-Native Infrastructures: Zero-Trust Security in Practice
sessions.description: An offensive and defensive security review of modern container environments, identity-aware proxies, credential rotation, and automated vulnerability scanning in CI/CD pipelines.

sessions.title: Modern Web Performance in Africa: Taming JavaScript and Latency
sessions.description: A deep dive into optimizing Web Vitals, Island architectures, streaming SSR, and edge caching to deliver sub-second page loads on 3G and 4G networks.

sessions.title: MLOps Under the Sun: Deploying and Monitoring Models with Low Latency
sessions.description: How to establish reproducible feature stores, drift detection, and automated canary rollouts for production credit and risk assessment models.

sessions.title: Lake Region Tech Lunch & Community Showcase
sessions.description: Enjoy traditional and contemporary Kisumu delicacies by the lake while demoing innovative student and startup projects.

sessions.title: Resilient Distributed Microservices with Go and Kubernetes
sessions.description: Writing blazingly fast backend services with Go 1.25+, gRPC, circuit breakers, and custom Kubernetes controllers that recover gracefully from regional outages.

sessions.title: Building Flutter Apps with On-Device AI & Offline-First Sync
sessions.description: Learn how to embed quantized Gemini Nano models on modern Android and iOS devices using Flutter, coupled with PowerSync and SQLite for 100% offline functionality.

sessions.title: Panel Discussion: Navigating Tech Careers & Remote Work in Africa
sessions.description: A frank, high-impact conversation between founders, tech leads, and remote developers on hiring trends, portfolio building, and thriving as an engineer from Western Kenya.

sessions.title: Lightning Talks & Community Demos
sessions.description: Fast-paced 7-minute presentations from local developers showing off hacks, open-source projects, and new ideas.

sessions.title: Closing Ceremony, Swag Handouts & Sundowner Networking
sessions.description: Celebration of speakers, volunteers, sponsors, and raffle winners followed by a networking sundowner with sunset views over Lake Victoria.
